reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: Disappointed. I am a return buyer and loved the product until they changed the pads. I wrote a review on here on 2023/03/22 giving 5 stars but I took off 3 stars because they "renewed" it without noting. The new version's pads are made of thicker rough material and now it is difficult to separate the pads into 2, which previously made this cost-efficient. Now, I am forced to use super soaked pads only once and run out quicker. If I am able to separate it into 2, it leaves fuzz and debris all over, which is frustrating. I also feel like the formula might have changed since it does not heal my rough hands or my acne spot fast compared to past 3 jars I purchased. I guess it's time for me to find other pads. I will attach the comparison picture of the older version and a newer one as a reference.
reviews.zh: 好失望。我係回購客，一直都好鍾意呢款產品，直至佢哋換咗棉片。我喺 2023/03/22 喺度寫過評價俾咗 5 星，但依家要扣 3 星，因為佢哋「更新」咗都冇講。新版嘅棉片用咗更厚更粗糙嘅物料，而家好難將棉片撕開兩份，之前可以撕開就覺得好抵用。而家逼住我每次用浸到好濕嘅棉片一次就用完，消耗速度快咗好多。如果勉強撕開兩份，就會留低成面棉碎同碎屑，好煩。我仲覺得配方可能都改咗，因為佢唔似以前嗰三罐咁快醫好我粗糙嘅手同暗瘡印。睇嚟係時候要搵其他棉片。我會貼埋舊版同新版嘅對比圖畀大家參考。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I definitely can see the difference when I use it every day 2x vs. when I don't use it for awhile. I recently stopped using it for about a month because I was lazy (lol) and I noticed that my face isn't as clear/smooth. So, I am going to be as consistent as possible to get back to where my skin condition was. I've left a review a couple of times saying how effective it is towards scars in general by helping them heal super fast. Also, my redness appears to have lessened when I used it consistently. The plus side is that you can divide each pad into 3 or 2, which lasts much longer. Definitely try it out!
reviews.zh: 我每日用兩次同隔一段時間唔用，對比真係好明顯。我最近成個月冇用，因為懶（笑），就發現塊面冇之前咁乾淨平滑。所以我會盡量keep住用，等皮膚回到之前嘅狀態。我之前寫過幾次評價，講過佢對疤嘅修復真係好有效，可以加速癒合。仲有，持續用嘅時候我發覺泛紅情況有減少。好處係每片棉片可以撕成 3 份或者 2 份，襟用好多。真心推介大家試吓！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I highly recommend this! I haven't used face pads for more than 15 years but I decided to try this one out because I heard it is great for combination skin that is acne prone. I've been using it for awhile and I can see that it tends to heal my acne scars really fast compared to before using this face pad. It also doesn't break me out and provides enough moisture. It also gently exfoliates well. I've even tried it on my hands after finishing using it on my face and neck. My hands have never been this soft before because of the habit of washing hands constantly due to being a germaphobe my entire life. Also, it faded the scar on my hand from a chemical burn back in October. I was worried that the scar won't go away but it really faded the scar super fast after using it for over 2 weeks. I will probably buy more when it runs out. So far, it's been lasting pretty long as it can be split into 3 layers.
reviews.zh: 我極度推薦呢款！我已經超過 15 年冇用過面片，不過聽講呢款好啱容易生暗瘡嘅混合性肌，所以就決定試吓。用咗一段時間之後，我發現佢比起之前用嘅時候真係可以快好多咁修復我嘅暗瘡印。佢亦都唔會令我爆瘡，而且保濕度足夠。仲可以溫和地去角質。我用完塊面同條頸之後，仲試過用嚟抹手。因為我成日洗手（我有潔癖），所以隻手從來都冇咁軟過。仲有，佢將我十月嗰陣化學燙傷留低嘅疤痕都褪咗色。我本來擔心嗰道疤會唔會好返，但用咗兩個星期之後真係褪得好快。用完之後我應該會再回購。暫時嚟講，因為可以撕成 3 層，所以都好襟用。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I decided to try these instead of the carrot ones because I have combo skin and I wanted a toner pad that is slightly exfoliating. It exfoliates gently without irritating my skin!
reviews.zh: 我揀咗呢款而唔揀紅蘿蔔嗰款，因為我係混合性肌，想搵一款有少少去角質效果嘅爽膚棉片。佢可以溫和地去角質，又唔會刺激到我塊面！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I will buy this one over and over again. Love this one more than carrot pads. Very good scent, moisturising and soothing. I've using this one everyday as mask pack -leave onto skin for 10 to 15 mins and it makes my skin like baby's
reviews.zh: 我會一直回購呢一隻。相比胡蘿蔔片我更鍾意呢款。氣味好聞，又保濕又舒緩。我每日都用佢嚟做面膜——敷喺皮膚上 10 至 15 分鐘，用完皮膚好似 BB 咁滑。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: Great toner pad! the cotton pad itself is thick but you can separate it apart easily to make it into two. The pad is also soft and i no irritation on the skin. The good amount of essence on the pad and product. It’s great oily skin in winter and summer!
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅爽膚水棉片！棉片本身厚，但好容易可以一分為二。棉片都好柔軟，皮膚無刺激。棉片同支裝嘅精華量都好足。油性肌冬天同夏天用都好啱！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I love these more than the carrot ones! I’ve been using the carrot ones before these came out and felt like it was too much for me as I have more oily skin overall. After trying these, I am in love with them. They are soft and light and hydrates my skin enough that I don’t feel like it’s too much. Will be repurchasing more when I run out.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢款多過胡蘿蔔嗰款！呢款未出之前我一直用緊胡蘿蔔嗰款，但因為我整體皮膚偏油性，覺得太厚重。試咗呢款之後即刻愛上。佢哋又軟又輕，幫皮膚保濕之餘又唔會覺得太厚重。用晒之後一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Water Parsley Clear Pad 60 Pads Special Offer (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: Made my skin much cleaner. I don’t get as much sebum on my face anymore and it provides enough moisture in cold weather. My cheek acne has significantly decreased since I started using it so I keep repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 皮膚明顯乾淨咗。塊面無以前咁多油脂，喺寒冷天氣下都夠保濕。開始用咗之後，兩頰嘅暗瘡明顯減少，所以我不斷回購！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
